text:
ali (Docs): ping — PR #789 updated the rate-limits + quotas page but several links to the metering/dashboard pages 404. Also need a short SDK migration snippet from v2 -> v3 for metering headers. Can someone help review?

marta (Platform): which links are 404ing? we changed the observability routes last quarter so some slugs moved. paste the failing URL?

ali (Docs): the PR points to https://console.redwood.example/metrics/metering-dashboard which 404s in prod. I drafted a replacement to /observability/metering but want to be sure we use the canonical public path. also debating wording: 'burst quota' vs 'burst credits' — any preference?

jason (SDK): I can add v3 snippets. prefer python first? also, quick note: the SDK now surfaces a billing header 'X-Redwood-Billing-Units' that teams can use to attribute cost. example JS snippet I was thinking:

```js
// send usage with billing header (client-side example)
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.example/v1/usage', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'X-Redwood-Billing-Units': 'tokens:350'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({route: '/generate', tokens: 350})
});
const j = await res.json();
console.log('billing_units', j.billing_units);
```

jason (SDK): will add similar python snippet for server-side.

kevin (Analytics): prefer python first for ops docs. also note: we renamed 'embedding-units' -> 'billing-units' in the analytics schema last fall — migration note should call that out and give the mapping table.

marta (Platform): confirmed canonical public slug is https://console.redwood.example/observability/metering (not /metrics). I can add an internal redirect but prefer docs update to avoid the redirect dependency.

ali (Docs): ok i'll change links to /observability/metering. Draft migration blurb I'll add: 'Field rename: analytics v1 "embedding-units" is now "billing_units"; please map embedding-units -> billing_units in downstream queries.' want to include a small mapping snippet in the migration guide.

kevin (Analytics): numbers check — the PR currently lists tier quotas (Free: 100K tokens/mo; Starter: 5M) those are stale. canonical from billing-service:

```
Free: 200000 tokens/month
Starter: 5000000 tokens/month
Business: custom (contact sales)
```

kevin (Analytics): also recommend a short sentence explaining metering granularity (per-request token rounding rules) — folks keep asking why totals differ versus naive token counts.

jason (SDK): here's the python server-side example I'll drop into the docs (short):

```py
import requests
url = 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/usage'
headers = {
  'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("RW_KEY")}',
  'X-Redwood-Billing-Units': 'tokens:120'
}
resp = requests.post(url, json={'route': '/chat', 'tokens': 120}, headers=headers)
print(resp.json().get('billing_units'))
```

ali (Docs): perfect — i'll include both snippets and the migration table. also planning to add a tiny dashboard screenshot and a note under 'rate limits' that burst behavior is governed by 'burst credits' (per kevin's earlier ops doc) — so i'll use the term 'burst credits' not 'burst quota'.

marta (Platform): fine with 'burst credits' term. add a release effective date in the doc: 2025-02-01 — helps support and sales callouts.

deploy-bot: docs-ci/build #789 passed with warnings — 1 broken link still flagged: /old-metrics/metering.

ali (Docs): i'll replace remaining /old-metrics/* references, squash and push. assigning final checks to @kevin (Analytics) and @jason (SDK) — please ACK when you have a look. :thumbsup:

kevin (Analytics): ACK — will review numbers and mapping table now.

jason (SDK): ACK — will sanity-check snippets and add a quick note about HTTP header casing and backwards compat.

ali (Docs): thanks team, will merge once CI is clean and both ACKs are back in the thread.
